page.title: Preferences
page.description: Real usable settings: in-game notification control and team danger-zone actions.

notifications.title: In-Game Notifications
notifications.description: Core game notifications and paid Staff Advisor notifications are controlled separately.
notifications.coreDescription: Normal game notifications that remain available without a paid Staff Advisor.
notifications.advisorDescription: Paid advisor notifications grouped by topic. Switching a category off mutes every notification type in that topic. Individual notification types can then be unmuted from their notification card without changing this category checkbox.
notifications.advisorSaveError: Could not save the Staff Advisor notification setting. Please try again.
notifications.advisorInactiveSuffix: Activate the required Staff Advisor to control this notification.
notifications.coreAdvisorNote: A Core notification and an Advisor notification may cover the same topic without being the same event. Example: Race Supplies Low remains Core, while Equipment & Workshop Review is paid analysis.

race.title: Race notifications
race.description: Invitations, preparation, weather, stage plans, race-day issues, and results.

team.title: Team & rider notifications
team.description: Riders, staff, transfers, training camps, scouting, and retirements.

club.title: Club management notifications
club.description: Finance, coins, rewards, supplies, equipment, tax, and infrastructure.

account.title: Account & system notifications
account.description: Official game messages and onboarding information.

raceInvitations.label: Race invitations
raceInvitations.description: Show notifications when your team receives a race invitation.

raceApplicationResults.label: Race application results
raceApplicationResults.description: Show notifications when your team is accepted or declined for a race.

races.label: Race day updates
races.description: Show startlist, missed-startlist, race-day, and race penalty updates.

racePreparation.label: Race preparation status
racePreparation.description: Show Core status and consequence notifications for race preparation. Proactive rider-deadline advice belongs to Sports Director Advisory.

stagePlanReminders.label: Stage plan status
stagePlanReminders.description: Show Core stage-plan opening and lock-state notifications. Missing-plan advice belongs to Sports Director Advisory.

raceWeather.label: Race weather
raceWeather.description: Show notifications when stages, races, or race-related activities are affected by weather.

raceResults.label: Race results
raceResults.description: Show notifications for finished races, stage results, classifications, and race summaries.

teamUpdates.label: Team updates
teamUpdates.description: Show notifications related to riders, morale, health, contracts, staff, and internal team changes.

staffContracts.label: Staff contracts
staffContracts.description: Show notifications about expiring staff contracts and renewal timing.

staffCourses.label: Staff courses
staffCourses.description: Show notifications when a staff course is completed and gains are applied.

transferUpdates.label: Transfer updates
transferUpdates.description: Show rider transfer, free agent, bid, offer, and negotiation notifications.

trainingCamps.label: Training camps
trainingCamps.description: Show notifications for training camp starts, daily reports, weather warnings, and completions.

scoutingReports.label: Scouting reports
scoutingReports.description: Show notifications when a scouting report is completed.

retirementUpdates.label: Retirement updates
retirementUpdates.description: Show notifications when riders or staff announce retirement and when retirements are finalized.

financeAlerts.label: Finance alerts
financeAlerts.description: Show important finance warnings, sponsor objectives, emergency loans, tax alerts, payroll issues, and insolvency notices.

walletRewards.label: Coins & rewards
walletRewards.description: Show coin purchases, coin credits, birthday gifts, referral rewards, and wallet reward messages.

competitionRewards.label: Competition rewards
competitionRewards.description: Show season rollover rewards for league and competition results.

taxUpdates.label: Tax updates
taxUpdates.description: Show notifications for tax audits and tax-related finance events.

raceSupplies.label: Race supplies
raceSupplies.description: Show notifications when race supplies are low, missing, or need restocking before events.

equipmentUpdates.label: Equipment updates
equipmentUpdates.description: Show notifications for equipment maintenance, sales, discard actions, and equipment lifecycle updates.

infrastructureUpdates.label: Infrastructure updates
infrastructureUpdates.description: Show notifications for infrastructure orders, deliveries, repairs, sales, upgrades, and condition warnings.

systemMessages.label: System messages
systemMessages.description: Show welcome messages and general official game messages.

trainingReadiness.label: Training & Rider Readiness
trainingReadiness.description: Training load, fatigue, rider availability, training gaps, squad readiness and rider development advisories.

raceProgrammePreparation.label: Race Programme & Preparation
raceProgrammePreparation.description: Race programme reviews and gaps, missing race preparation and preparation-ready advisories.

startlistStagePlans.label: Startlist & Stage Plans
startlistStagePlans.description: Startlist deadline alerts plus missing or incomplete stage-plan advisories.

medicalRecovery.label: Medical & Recovery
medicalRecovery.description: Medical reports, injury and illness treatment plans, recovery changes and medical-clearance advisories.

equipmentWorkshopSupplies.label: Equipment, Workshop & Race Supplies
equipmentWorkshopSupplies.description: Equipment condition, workshop readiness and analytical race-supply review advisories.

scoutingRecruitment.label: Scouting & Recruitment
scoutingRecruitment.description: Recruitment intelligence, scouting review and priority-prospect advisories.

developingTeam.title: Developing Team
developingTeam.description: Build and manage a U23 development squad with seasonal coin access.
developingTeam.eligibility: Eligibility: 30 real-life days or 60 in-game days.
developingTeam.expiredDescription: Your team, riders, contracts, results and history remain stored. The Developing Team is currently read-only.
developingTeam.notEligibleDescription: Developing Team becomes available after 30 real-life days or 60 in-game days.
developingTeam.teamNameRule: The team name will be your main club name plus U23.
developingTeam.raceRule: This team can apply to races normally while seasonal access is active.
developingTeam.competitionRule: This team cannot be promoted above Continental level.
developingTeam.ageRule: Only riders aged 23 or younger are eligible.
developingTeam.movementRule: Riders move between squads only during movement windows.

dangerZone.title: Danger Zone
dangerZone.description: These are destructive actions and should stay separated from normal preferences.
dangerZone.restartDescription: Restart this club back to a fresh starter state while keeping the same club name, logo, jersey, country, and competition slot.
dangerZone.restartDetail: Current riders become free agents, season points reset to 0, and the team receives a new starter squad based on its current tier.
dangerZone.shutdownDescription: Permanently delete this user team AND the authentication account. After successful deletion, you will be redirected to the homepage and may sign up again with the same email.
dangerZone.shutdownDetail: This should delete only the current user’s team data, not other users or other teams.
dangerZone.systemNote: The notification system should check these saved preferences before creating or showing each notification type.
dangerZone.confirmDescription: This action is permanent and cannot be undone.
dangerZone.aboutToDelete: You are about to permanently delete:
dangerZone.deleteGameData: Your team riders, equipment, and team-related game data
dangerZone.deleteAccount: Your authentication account for this email
dangerZone.afterDelete: After successful deletion, you will be signed out and redirected to the homepage. You may then register again with the same email address as a brand-new user.
dangerZone.exactDeleteError: You must type DELETE exactly to confirm this action.
dangerZone.missingSession: Your session is missing. Please sign in again and retry.
dangerZone.shutdownUnexpected: Failed to shut down team due to an unexpected error.
